mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% indicates significant labor market deterioration, triggering reduced consumer spending and corporate profit concerns that produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE > 7.5%) and negative month-over-month nonfarm payrolls growth (PAYEMS MoM change < 0) signal labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 900.0 units), rising housing starts signal strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in industrial production growth below 0.5% indicates manufacturing slowdown and economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM change < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 900.0) and retail sales (RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5%) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), a rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months indicates improving labor market conditions and rising consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
